parameters.query:
SELECT to_jsonb(l.*) AS lead,
       to_jsonb(o.*) AS org,
       rr_can_contact(l.id, coalesce(NULLIF($2::text,''), 'sms')) AS can_contact,
       (SELECT to_jsonb(a.*) FROM appointments a
         WHERE a.lead_id = l.id AND a.status IN ('SCHEDULED','CONFIRMED') AND a.start_at > NOW()
         ORDER BY a.start_at LIMIT 1) AS upcoming_appointment
FROM leads l JOIN organizations o ON o.id = l.organization_id
WHERE l.id = $1::uuid;
SELECT id, name, timezone, settings FROM organizations WHERE id = $1::uuid;
SELECT rr_log_event($1::uuid, $2::uuid, '06_AI_CONVERSATION', 'SKIPPED_NO_CONTACT', $3::jsonb) AS id, false AS sent, 'blocked_or_paused' AS reason, $2::uuid AS lead_id;

INSERT INTO ai_interactions (organization_id, lead_id, conversation_id, workflow, model, input, output,
                             action, confidence, valid, error, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, NULLIF($3::text,'')::uuid, $4::text, $5::text, $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb,
        NULLIF($8::text,''), $9::numeric, $10::boolean, NULLIF($11::text,''), $12::int, $13::int)
RETURNING id;

parameters.content:
## 06 · Conversation
Modes: FIRST_CONTACT · ANSWER · QUALIFY · OFFER_SLOTS · NO_SLOTS · DISQUALIFIED · FOLLOWUP · POST_CALL.
Guardrails reject prices, booking claims, unsafe advice, "I'm human", and self-invented times → safe fallback text.
In OFFER_SLOTS the model writes one sentence; the numbered slot list is appended from workflow 09 output.
